scope: Prospectively specified numerical verification of a generic continuous cold-to-power model. No measured plant startup data or independent plant-validation pass is claimed.
amendmentPolicy: Retain this initial protocol. Any later acceptance change requires a separately identified amendment with the failed result and engineering reason; do not silently widen a limit.

fullTrajectory.note: The neutron fraction is normalized to the model's nominal fission power. It does not incorrectly require fission heat alone to equal total nominal reactor heat including decay heat. Scenario command timing is a declared generic design input, never a measured-data fit.

kinetics.sourceEquilibriumReference: n = -S Lambda / rho with each normalized precursor equal to n
kinetics.transientReference: Independent augmented 8x8 constant-coefficient matrix exponential including a constant source, with seven kinetic states and one affine coordinate.

synchronization.note: Each rejected condition is isolated in an admissible initialization with other conditions satisfied. Mechanical speed, electrical phase and voltage are native states/derived observations, not forced result values. The actual model permissive thresholds are documented generic design assumptions, not licensed plant settings.

continuity.eventAccounting: Inventory changes at synchronization and trips must remain accounted for by the same integrated external fluxes. Observe primitive neutron, precursor, thermal, water and rotor states across the transition.

sources.role: Point-kinetics equations and independently published numerical benchmark methodology
